## Maintenance Type (ISO/IEC 14764)
- [ ] Corrective (Bug fix)
- [ ] Adaptive (Environment/dependency change)
- [ ] Perfective (New feature / performance improvement)
- [ ] Preventive (Refactoring / debt reduction)

## Semantic Versioning Impact
- [ ] PATCH (Backward-compatible bug fix or internal refactoring)
- [ ] MINOR (Backward-compatible new feature or deprecation)
- [ ] MAJOR (Breaking API change)

## Evolution Quality Checklist
- [ ] Characterisation/regression tests added or updated
- [ ] All automated tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] ESLint passes with 0 new warnings (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] No unintended dependencies introduced
